knowledgeAnswers.rationale: When failures repeat before the annual service, a fixed date is not enough. Add condition-based checks, propose authorised servicing for the recurring fault, and record the reason.
Preventive work is approved in writing before it starts.
The lesson says that where no manufacturer guidance is held, the worker says so and sets an interval based on the item's criticality and history, and reviews it.

passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Escalate repeated defects using priority and responsible-owner fields; set review date without assuming repair completion.
Describe the responsible referral and documentary trail
